name: Jeeter | 1g Liquid Diamond Disposable | Strawberry Sour Diesel
description:
Strawberry Sour Diesel crosses two legacy strains, Sour Diesel and Strawberry Cough, to create a fruity sativa with a serious gas kick. Expect sweet, candied strawberry on the inhale with hints of floral, followed by a sharp exhale of citrusy pine and classic diesel. Bold, flavorful, and perfect for on the go, this one’s got range.

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
